verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; the top campaign is being corrected now.
narrative: Ad return fell 81% week-over-week to a 28-day blended ROAS of 3.54, and the last six days (Aug 13–18) recorded zero purchases and zero revenue — this is a confirmed drop, not a data gap. The subscription box campaign, which took 57% of total spend this period, continued running through that purchase drought and is being pulled back immediately. A single transaction on Aug 17 produced a brief uptick, but the underlying purchase rate remains near zero. New creative is being prioritized to replace the fatigued ads currently in market, and ad spend is being redirected toward formats with recent conversion history. Expect the creative refresh and campaign restructure to be in place before the end of August, with purchase volume the metric to watch over the next reporting window.
